  ```sh
  CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
  ```

- OD-122 persona/config and OD-123 Cozo/native-memory remain deferred. Cognitive alias/HOT-policy migration is separate debt.

- User requests plan-first/deep handling and JEV relevance filtering before full candidate reads.
- No retained eval runtime existed at resume; current turn initialized a `judge` call through `functions.eval`, but do not assume runtime survives another context.
